adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is explicitly set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,`). A few lines later, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which is a no-op when `destinationCalendar` is `null` due to optional chaining, silently dropping all collected team member destination calendars. Initializing to `[]` or reassigning via a spread as suggested would be necessary to preserve the calendars.
